_comment: AI provider credentials, managed from the Credentials page. One entry per service or relay; Dev Setup reads these when pointing a device's AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) at an endpoint. Keys stored here never leave the gateway except into the config files Dev Setup writes on machines you own.
_comment_fields: kind is anthropic | openai | gemini | custom. base_url empty means the service's default endpoint; set it for relays or self-hosted gateways. id is assigned by the panel.
